actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.listMessages.description: Lists an Messages via Bird Channels API
actions.listMessages.props.endAt.descrip: The end date and time (in UTC) to filter messages, should not exceed 7 days from start date
actions.listMessages.props.pageToken.des: Token for pagination to fetch next set of results after 1000 messages
actions.listMessages.props.startAt.descr: The start date and time (in UTC) to filter messages
actions.listMessages.props.status.descri: The status of the messages to filter by (select "All" for all statuses)
actions.send-sms.description: Sends an SMS message via Bird Channels API.
actions.send-sms.props.message.descripti: The body of the SMS message
actions.send-sms.props.recipient.descrip: The phone number to send the message to (with country code)
actions.send-sms.props.reference.descrip: Your own identifier for the message (optional)
actions.send-sms.props.scheduledFor.desc: Message to be sent at a specific datetime eg. 2025-04-27T15:08:18.613Z. If not set, the message will be sent immediately.
auth.props.apiKey.description: Bird API Access Key from Settings > Security > Access Keys
